options.systemMessage: You write concise, honest B2B cold emails for CodeNativeX. Never invent facts. Follow the requested JSON shape exactly.

parameters.jsCode:
const value = $json || {};
return {
  json: {
    ...value,
    id: value.id,
    job_id: value.job_id || '',
    outreach_id: value.outreach_id,
    outreach_attempt_number: Math.max(1, Number(value.outreach_attempt_number || 1)),
    company_name: value.company_name || '',
    email: value.email || '',
    email_subject: value.email_subject || '',
    email_body: value.email_body || '',
    outreach_outcome: value.outreach_outcome || 'failed',
    final_status: value.final_status || 'outreach_failed',
    final_outreach_status: value.final_outreach_status || 'failed',
    gmail_message_id: value.gmail_message_id || '',
    gmail_thread_id: value.gmail_thread_id || '',
    first_outreach_at: value.first_outreach_at || null,
    last_outreach_at: value.last_outreach_at || null,
    next_follow_up_at: value.next_follow_up_at || null,
    final_next_workflow: value.final_next_workflow || '',
    final_error: value.final_error || '',
    completed_at: new Date().toISOString()
  }
};
